blocks.text: Chromosomal mutations genes ki jagah ya chromosomes ki banawat ya tadaad mein bari tabdeeliyan hain. Yeh aam taur par khud-ba-khud hoti hain.

Chromosomal rearrangements jismani tabdeeliyan hain jaise deletions, duplications, inversions aur translocations, aam taur par DNA double helix ke do jagah se tootne se. Translocation mein aik chromosome ka hissa doosre ka hissa ban jata hai; inversion mein chromosome ke hisse ka rukh ulat jata hai.

blocks.alt: A se G hisson wala chromosome, B aur C ke darmiyan centromere. Deletion se A B E F G. Duplication se A B C B C D E F G. Inversion se A D C B E F G. A se G aur M se R ke darmiyan translocation se A B C P Q R aur M N O D E F G.
blocks.caption: Deletion, duplication, inversion aur translocation (kitab ki rearrangements wali Figure 19.24 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chromosomal rearrangements chromosome ki banawat badalti hain, aksar jab DNA double helix do jagah se toot jaye. Deletion mein aik hissa ghayab hota; duplication mein aik hissa dohraya jata; inversion mein aik hissa ulat kar us ki tarteeb ulti ho jati; aur translocation mein aik chromosome ka hissa doosre ka hissa ban jata hai, yahan do non-homologous chromosomes ke tabadle ki shakal mein.

blocks.text: Insertional inactivation: DNA ke bohat se chhote tukre, transposons ya jumping genes, genome mein aik jagah se doosri ja sakte aur nayi jaghein ittefaqan chunte hain. Kuch genes mein ghus kar unhein nakara kar dete hain; yeh qudrat mein aam hai aur bohat si insani genetic bimariyan isi se hain. Kitab ki misaal X chromosome par clotting factor IX ke gene mein insani transposon ka ghusna hai jo gene ke beech stop codon rakh deta aur X-linked haemophilia karta hai.

Kabhi kabhi meiosis mein chromosomes theek alag nahi hote, to gamete mein aik chromosome barh ya ghat jata hai. Ise non-disjunction kehte hain; agar aisa gamete zygote banaye to fard mein shadeed kharabiyan ho sakti hain. Yeh autosomes ya sex chromosomes mein ho sakti hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat: maa ki umr
blocks.text: Non-disjunction waqt ke saath sperm ke muqable mein eggs mein kaheen zyada mumkin hai, kyunke aurat ke sab mustaqbil ke eggs us ki paidaish tak prophase I tak pohanch chuke hote hain, yaani woh us jitne hi purane hote hain, jab ke mard rozana naye sperm banate hain. Is liye maa ki umr baap se zyada ahem hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: insani karyotype ka khaaka, 22 numbered autosome jore, neele aur gulabi saathi, chromosome 21 ki teen copies surkh ghere mein. Neeche: 44 autosomes ke saath sex chromosome sets: XX (46) normal aurat, XY (46) normal mard, XXY (47) Klinefelter, XO (45) Turner jis mein khaali dashed jagah, aur XXX (47) triple X.
blocks.caption: Down syndrome aur sex chromosome sets (Figures 19.25 aur 19.26 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chromosomes ki tadaad ki ghaltiyan non-disjunction se hoti hain. Down syndrome mein chromosome 21 ki teen copies, kul 47 chromosomes (2n+1). Klinefelter syndrome 44 autosomes aur XXY (47) wala mard hai; Turner syndrome 44 autosomes aur aik X, XO (45, 2n-1), wali aurat; triple X XXX (47) wali aurat hai. Khaaka saada hai, paimane par nahi.

blocks.text: Chromosomes ki kul tadaad 47 (2n+1) hai. Ise pehli baar 1866 mein J. Langdon Down ne bayan kiya aur yeh taqreeban har 750 mein se aik bachche ko hota hai. Yeh autosome jore 21 ki non-disjunction se hota hai jo egg bante waqt ho sakti hai: jora alag nahi hota, 24 chromosomes ka egg banta hai, aur normal sperm se fertilization ke baad trisomy 21 wala bachcha, larka ya larki, paida hota hai. Alamaat mein zehni kami, ruki nashonuma, gardan ki pusht par zyada jild, chapti chehre ki banawat, chhota sar, chhoti gardan aur aaza, oopar ko jhuki aankhein, chhote kaan, kamzor muscles, bahar nikli zabaan aur dil ke nuqs shamil hain. Mard aam taur par baanjh aur auratein kam zarkhez hoti hain. Achhi dekh bhaal, aam masail ki screening, ilaaj, achha khandani mahol aur khaas taleem, zindagi behtar karti hai.

blocks.alt: Aik jaal. Ghair maamooli eggs XX aur O pehlu mein, normal sperm X aur Y oopar. XX egg aur X sperm se 44 + XXX, triple X aurat (47); XX aur Y se 44 + XXY, Klinefelter mard (47); O aur X se 44 + XO, Turner aurat (45); O aur Y se 44 + OY, zinda nahi reh sakta.
blocks.caption: Maa mein X chromosomes ki non-disjunction (Figure 19.27 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Agar maa mein meiosis ke dauran X chromosomes alag na hon to egg ko dono X (XX) ya koi nahi (O) mil sakta hai. XX egg X sperm se fertilize ho to triple X (XXX); Y sperm se Klinefelter syndrome (XXY). O egg X sperm se fertilize ho to Turner syndrome (XO); OY zygote nahi barhta kyunke insan X ke genes ke baghair zinda nahi reh sakta. Baap mein non-disjunction bhi XY sperm de sakti hai jo normal egg se XXY deta, ya baghair sex chromosome ka sperm jo XO deta hai.

blocks.text: Agar maa mein X chromosomes alag na hon to egg ko dono X (XX) ya koi nahi (O) mil sakta hai. XX egg Y sperm se fertilize ho to 47 chromosomes (44 + XXY) wala XXY banta hai; baap mein non-disjunction bhi XY sperm de sakti hai jo normal X egg ke saath XXY deta hai. Yeh Klinefelter syndrome hai jo American tabeeb Harry Klinefelter ke naam par hai jinhon ne 1942 mein ise bayan kiya. Mutasir larke baanjh mard bante hain jin mein kuch zanana khasiyatein (jism par kam baal, chhati ka barhna), chhote testes, lambi taangein, chhota dhar, koolhon jitne kandhe aur kam bhaari awaaz hoti hai. Ilaaj mein balooghat se testosterone, chhati ke tissue ka operation, aur zabaan, school aur samaji mushkilaat ke liye rawaiye ki therapy shamil hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat: triple X
blocks.text: XX egg X sperm se fertilize ho to 47 chromosomes aur XXX wali larki, yaani triple X syndrome. Aisi auraton mein seekhne ki mushkilaat, lamba qad aur door door aankhein ho sakti hain; woh zarkhez hoti aur balooghat maamool ki umr par hoti hai.

O egg aur Y sperm se OY zygote banta hai jo nahi barhta, kyunke insan X chromosome ke genes ke baghair zinda nahi reh sakta. O egg aur X sperm, ya O sperm aur X egg, se 45 chromosomes, XO (2n-1 ya 44 + XO), wali larki banti hai, yaani sex chromosomes ki monosomy: Turner syndrome, jise American mahir-e-ghudood Henry Turner ne 1938 mein pehli baar bayan kiya. Alamaat mein chhota qad, jaali dar (webbed) gardan, na pukhta jinsi aaza aur baanjhpan, aur chhoti thodi aur jabra shamil hain; kitab kam zehni salahiyat bhi likhti hai, halanke Turner syndrome wali zyada tar larkiyon ki zehanat normal hoti hai, kabhi khaas seekhne ki mushkilaat ke saath. Yeh jigar aur gurde ke masail, motape, diabetes aur high blood pressure se juri hai. Kitab is ki shareh taqreeban 5000 larkiyon ki paidaish mein aik deti hai; aksar zaraye taqreeban 2000 se 2500 mein aik batate hain. Bachpan mein jaldi shuru kiya growth hormone qad barhata aur estrogen ka mutabadil ilaaj sanwi jinsi khasiyatein laata hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat: zyada ya kam autosomes
blocks.text: Aik autosome kam wala zygote nashonuma mukammal nahi kar sakta, aur zyada tar aik zyada autosome wale bhi zinda nahi rehte. Taham chromosomes 13, 15, 18, 21 aur 22 teen copies mein ho sakte aur fard kuch arsa zinda reh sakta hai. Zyada 13, 15 ya 18 shadeed nuqs aur chand maheenon mein maut ka sabab hai; zyada 21 ya 22 wale aam taur par jawani tak zinda rehte hain, haddiyon ki der se pukhtagi, chhote qad, kamzor muscles aur mutasir zehni nashonuma ke saath.

blocks.prompt: 45 saal ki aurat ke 25 saal ki aurat se zyada Down syndrome wala bachcha hone ka imkaan kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Us ke eggs paidaish se pehle se prophase I mein ruke hain, yaani 45 saal purane, aur eggs ki umr ke saath non-disjunction ka imkaan barhta hai.
